property_summary: After Command is called with any non-zero msg.value, the contract's ETH balance must be strictly less than its balance before the call plus msg.value because a low-level call forwards some ETH (gas costs aside); the buggy version retains all ETH, so balance_after == balance_before + msg.value, violating the strict inequality.
change_summary: Delete the low-level call, making Command a no-op that accepts ETH.
